interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain polarized decays, background correction and parameter linking.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Follow a guided tour through the real wizard controls.

interactive.label: [x] Welcome
interactive.tooltip: Build a linked VV/VH global anisotropy fit.

interactive.label: [ ] Data
interactive.tooltip: Select the polarisation-resolved IRF and decay files.

interactive.label: [x] Normalize IRF
interactive.tooltip: Pick a background region; IRFs are subtracted and intensity-matched.

interactive.label: [x] Corrections
interactive.tooltip: Instrumental g-factor and channel-mixing corrections.

interactive.label: [x] Components
interactive.tooltip: Define the lifetime and rotation spectra.

interactive.label: [x] Finish
interactive.tooltip: Create the linked VV/VH global anisotropy fit.

interactive.label: Back
interactive.tooltip: Return to the previous workflow step.

interactive.label: Next
interactive.tooltip: Continue to the next workflow step.

interactive.label: [x] Data
interactive.tooltip: Select the polarisation-resolved IRF and decay files.

interactive.label: irf_vv_path
interactive.tooltip: Path to the IRF VV/VH curve: type or paste it, press Enter, or use Browse.

interactive.label: Browse
interactive.tooltip: Choose the IRF VV/VH file from disk.

interactive.label: irf_vh_path
interactive.tooltip: Path to the IRF VH curve: type or paste it, press Enter, or use Browse.

interactive.label: Browse
interactive.tooltip: Choose the IRF VH file from disk.

interactive.label: data_vv_path
interactive.tooltip: Path to the Data VV/VH curve: type or paste it, press Enter, or use Browse.

interactive.label: Browse
interactive.tooltip: Choose the Data VV/VH file from disk.

interactive.label: data_vh_path
interactive.tooltip: Path to the Data VH curve: type or paste it, press Enter, or use Browse.

interactive.label: Browse
interactive.tooltip: Choose the Data VH file from disk.

interactive.label: Two stacked VV/VH files
interactive.tooltip: Each IRF/data file holds both polarization channels (one IRF file, one data file); otherwise choose four separate files.

interactive.label: First column is time (ns)
interactive.tooltip: Keep a measured time axis unchanged; otherwise the first column is treated as channel indices. Not used with stacked files.

interactive.label: Use file header
interactive.tooltip: Read available channel/calibration information from the file header.

interactive.label: bin_width
interactive.tooltip: Time per histogram channel for channel-index or stacked files; a time-axis column is preserved.

interactive.label: rep_rate
interactive.tooltip: Excitation repetition rate used to initialize the lifetime fits.

interactive.label: skiprows
interactive.tooltip: Number of header rows to skip while reading text decays.

interactive.label: Load / reload data
interactive.tooltip: Read all selected IRF and decay files, then initialize a background region.

interactive.label: Export corrected IRFs
interactive.tooltip: Save the two background-subtracted, intensity-matched IRFs with their time-bin width.

interactive.label: region_lb
interactive.tooltip: First background channel, inclusive; choose a signal-free region.

interactive.label: region_ub
interactive.tooltip: Last background channel boundary, exclusive.

interactive.label: g_factor
interactive.tooltip: Detection-efficiency ratio between the VV and VH channels; it scales the anisotropy as a whole.

interactive.label: l1
interactive.tooltip: Channel-mixing correction l1 of the parallel channel (high-aperture objectives).

interactive.label: l2
interactive.tooltip: Channel-mixing correction l2 of the perpendicular channel.

interactive.label: Save spectra
interactive.tooltip: Save the lifetime and rotation components as amplitude/value pairs in JSON.

interactive.label: Load spectra
interactive.tooltip: Replace both component lists from a saved spectrum file.

interactive.label: new_amplitude
interactive.tooltip: Amplitude of the component to add.

interactive.label: new_value
interactive.tooltip: Rotational correlation time of the component to add, in nanoseconds.

interactive.label: Add component
interactive.tooltip: Append the entered amplitude and correlation time.

interactive.label: Remove selected
interactive.tooltip: Remove the selected row (the last one when none is selected).

interactive.label: Create fits
interactive.tooltip: Create the VV, VH and global fits with configured spectra, corrected IRFs and linked parameters.
